slug: 2024-11-14 Tunisians Share How their Life Changed Through the AMEN Program
note: Mentions digitalised transfers and the AMEN social registry only; names no programme management information system.

facts.fact: The World Bank says the AMEN programme's management information system has been strengthened, speeding the beneficiary application process and eligibility verification.

The World Bank says the AMEN management information system is being enhanced, including interoperability with other agencies' databases, and a case management system is being established with UNDP under the SPLA project.
The World Bank says 44.4% of AMEN cash transfers are digitalised, with a convention between the Ministry of Social Affairs and the Tunisian Post for digital payment cards tied to an e-wallet.

claims.gtmi-4d1f855a08: nothing: a pension or social insurance system; the study assesses social assistance programmes
